DOCS-ONLY: fix four confirmed Codex Review findings on PR #781 (branch docs/v3-finder-rollout-honest-state, now rebased onto main; expected head 48859ca, fail closed if it moved) plus one verified stale line. Only docs/operations/v3-finder-production-rollout-state.md and docs/ROADMAP.md may change. Keep both the roadmap's numbered controlling sequence and the ops doc's step table in lockstep: same steps, same order, same numbering.

FINDING 1 (ops doc ~line 39, detached workers): the claim that the 2026-10-04 inspection 'still describes production' because no workflow has run is NOT sound: ratings-v4-generation.sh and v3-system-search-f1.sh launch detached worker containers (docker run -d) that can keep committing chunks and change generation/product lifecycle after the workflow finishes. Rewrite: no GOVERNED workflow has run since 2026-09-25 (keep the three dates), but detached workers dispatched earlier may still have been running; the 2026-10-04 state is therefore the last VERIFIED state, not a guarantee of the current one. Add a new first step to the remaining path (step 0 in the ops table and item 0 in the roadmap list, or renumber everything from 1 consistently): 'Re-run the read-only governed inspection (scripts/operator/actions/v3-derived-data-status.sh via the operator control plane) and confirm every relevant detached worker (edfinder-ratings-v4-prod-p4, edfinder-ratings-v4-prod-p4-opt1, edfinder-ratings-v4-prod-p4-parallel-v1, edfinder-v3-system-search-p4-opt1) has stopped; record generation and product lifecycle states before dispatching any migration apply'. Tooling status: exists (read-only).

FINDING 2 (ROADMAP ~line 163 and the ops doc's open decision, purge path): purge is NOT currently executable. Migration 006_v3_derived_product_lifecycle.sql line ~170 installs statement-level DELETE and TRUNCATE triggers on v3_derived.system_search that raise 'system_search rows and receipts are insert-only'. Rewrite the decision in both files: retaining opt1's ~198.5M rows is today the ONLY executable path; purging would first require a reviewed governed purge migration/action that does not exist. Phrase the decision as: either accept retention and confirm disk headroom for a second product, or add 'design and review a governed purge path' as a prerequisite before step 4. Do not present purge as an available branch.

FINDING 3 (ops doc ~line 120 and roadmap step order, validate before the second build): VALIDATE CONSTRAINT scans the whole table; done after the fresh build it scans ~397M rows instead of ~198.5M. Move the governed VALIDATE CONSTRAINT step to immediately after the migration apply step and before creating the fresh generation; note that later builder inserts remain checked automatically because NOT VALID checks enforce every subsequent insert. Renumber consistently in both files.

FINDING 4 (ROADMAP ~line 152, calibration probe): the roadmap text just above the sequence still calls the authorized read-only prod-sample coefficient-calibration probe a 'pre-build follow-up', but the sequence goes straight to the immutable system_archetype build; coefficients are hashed into the product manifest at registration and READY products cannot be rewritten. Insert 'Run the authorized read-only coefficient-calibration probe and record the coefficient decision' as its own step before the system_archetype build, in both files. Tooling status: 'NO governed action — must be built' (a repository search for calibration tooling under scripts/ and .github/ finds none; the probe can read the already-published parallel_v1 ratings vectors, so it does not wait for the fresh generation).

VERIFIED STALE LINE (ROADMAP ~lines 118-124): it still says the F2b review follow-ups are 'being addressed on fix/v3-finder-f2b-review-followups (PR #775, in review — NOT yet merged to main)' and 'main still carries the pre-fix builder'. PR #775 merged to main on 2026-09-28 as a928930. Correct that sentence to state the follow-ups merged (#775, a928930, 2026-09-28) and remove the 'treat those blockers as open' instruction.

Validate: both files render as Markdown; the roadmap list and the ops table have identical step order; git diff --name-only against the head lists only the two files.
